settings.heading: HOW TO REMOVE
settings.subtitle: PRESS-ON NAILS // PRESERVE YOUR SET
settings.introduction: Remove your press-ons gently to help protect your natural nails and keep the set for another scene. Never force off a nail that is still firmly attached.
settings.image_alt: NailScene removal infographic illustrating loosening a press-on nail, soaking briefly if needed, using nail-glue remover, cleaning adhesive residue, and storing the nails.
settings.note_body: Never pry off a nail that resists. If you feel pain or irritation, stop rather than forcing removal.

settings.title: LIFT THE EDGE
settings.description: Use a cuticle stick to gently loosen the side of the press-on nail.

settings.title: SOAK IF NEEDED
settings.description: If the nail remains firmly attached, soak it in warm water with dish soap for 1–2 minutes before trying to gently lift the edge again.

settings.title: APPLY REMOVER
settings.description: Apply nail-glue remover to the loosened sides. The supplied graphic says to wait 5 seconds; follow your remover product’s directions.

settings.title: REMOVE GENTLY
settings.description: Carefully ease the press-on away with a cuticle stick once the adhesive has loosened. Do not force it.

settings.title: CLEAN & BUFF
settings.description: Use an alcohol pad to wipe adhesive residue from your nail and press-on. Lightly buff away remaining residue with the nail file as needed.

settings.title: OIL & STORE
settings.description: Apply cuticle oil to your natural nails and store your press-ons back in their case for another scene.
